# Test fonts

`test.ttf` and `test.otf` are original box-shaped fonts generated by
`build_fonts.py`, under this repository's MIT license. They are deliberately
small and do not depend on installed production fonts. The TTF uses 2048 units
per em and the CFF font uses 1000; U+2026 and U+22EF share one glyph so tests can
exercise Unicode aliases. U+31350 is deliberately absent.

Regeneration requires Python with fontTools (`python3 tests/fixtures/build_fonts.py`).
Running `cargo test` only needs the checked-in binaries.
